LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS MILLA VAYNTRAUB, VLADISLAV CHERNOGUZ AND BIANA CHERNOGUZ'S MOTION TO STRIKE AMENEDED COMPLAINT AND DISMISS THE PLAINTIFF'S SLAPP ACTION IS DENIED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 7 BECAUSE THE ALLEGED CONDUCT IS NOT PROTECTED. DENIED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 4 BECAUSE ALTHOUGH THE ALLEGED CONDUCT INCLUDES PROTECTED ACTIVITY, PLAINTIFF HAS SHOWN A SUFFICIENT PROBABILITY OF SUCCESS, GIVEN THE DEFENDANT'S FAILURE TO REVERT TO PLAINTIFF'S SUBSEQUENT TO THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. GRANTED AS TO THE REMAINING CAUSES OF ACTION, WHICH ARISE FROM THE PROTECTED AND PRIVILEGED CONDUCT OF INSTITUTING EVICTION PROCEEDINGS, NEGOTIATING A PRE-LITIGATION SETTLEMENT, AND MAKING ALLEGEDLY FALSE STATEMENTS AS PART OF THOSE NEGOTIATIONS AT A TIME WHEN THE EVIDENCE INDICATES DEFENDANT INTENDED TO PROCEED WITH LITIGATION IF A SETTLEMENT WERE NOT REACHED. EVEN IF THEY WEREN'T PRIVILEGED, PLAINTIFF HAS PRESENTED NO EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT'S STATEMENTS CONCERNING INTENT TO MOVE IN WERE FALSE WHEN MADE. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189 (301/PJB)
